desc: Derive reformulation: per-row bounds L[x] ≤ r[x] ≤ U[x] with r non-increasing; equivalent to dominance condition: no W weakly northwest of a B (conflict iff B(x1,y1), W(x2,y2) with x2 ≤ x1 and y2 ≤ y1).
Design sweep: group cells by row; minW = min y of W in rows ≤ current; each B at (x,y) requires y < minW (using W's from rows ≤ x, including same row).
Write final Python solution with fast I/O, O(M log M), grouping by row via dict, iterating sorted rows; print Yes/No; verified against all four samples mentally (Yes/No/Yes/No).
